panel.title: Budget & cost control
panel.description: Internal budget for cost control — separate from client contract value. Compare budget to Actual, remaining commitment, ETC, and Forecast from the shared financial engine. Revisions never overwrite history.
panel.empty: No budget yet. Create a lightweight total budget when you are ready.

metrics.contractNote: Contract value lives under Financials / Changes — budget lines never replace it.
metrics.engineMissing: Actual and Forecast need project financials permission. Budget figures still show.
metrics.positionNote: Budget is the internal cost plan, separate from contract value. Actual is recognized cost. Committed is the open remaining commitment. ETC is the project's expected remaining cost and is included once in Forecast. Forecast is expected final cost. Variance is Budget minus Forecast.

lines.title: Budget lines
lines.mappingHint: Actual comes from the shared financial engine only. Category lines are mapped when the category key already matches an expense. Work-package lines map the same way. Discipline lines cannot be mapped and stay unmapped — nothing is invented for them. Cost-code lines stay unmapped unless that same category link already exists. Committed and the project's expected remaining cost stay on the total line and are not split across detail lines. A line ETC is planning only and is not added again on top of the project's expected remaining cost inside Forecast.
lines.unmappedRowHint: Engine Actual not matched to a category or work-package line. Includes labor, vendor bills, and expenses without those keys. Never guessed onto a line.

revisions.title: Revision history
revisions.historyHint: Earlier revisions stay on record. New amounts append a revision - nothing is silently rewritten.

actions.lightweightHint: Leave lines empty for a single total. Add category or work-package lines here when you want per-line Actual mapping.

trend.title: Monthly margin
trend.hint: Saved from the composed project margin for the open current month. Closed months are not rewritten. This is not a ledger and not cash.

errors.activeExists: An active budget already exists. Use revise instead.
errors.notActive: Only an active budget can be revised.
